verdict.rationale: Langfuse offers several bulk-oriented capabilities (Blob Storage Export for large volumes, Metrics API v2 for aggregate queries, Datasets for batch test cases, Annotation Queues for batch review, CLI/SDK access), suggesting it supports bulk operations across traces, scores, and prompts. However, community evidence notes the trace/generation retrieval API was 'brutally slow for bulk scanning operations,' forcing a user to bypass it via direct DB queries, indicating real limitations in scaled bulk workflows.
